newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ASJ Holdings gets approval for Singapore listing.
newsitem.headline: ASJ Holdings gets approval for Singapore listing.

text.p: Resistor manufacturer ASJ Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it had received approval in principle for a listing on Singapore's second board.
ASJ Holdings said in a statement it planned to list on the Stock Exchange of Singapore Dealing and Automated Quotation System (SESDAQ).

The company intended to improve its manufacturing process, increase its production capacity, expand distribution activity to Thailand and strengthen its distribution network in Malaysia, the statement said.
ASJ Holdings said Taiwan's Yageo Corp is a substantial shareholder.
Schroder International will manage the initial public offer, the statement said.
